summary: First-finish smoke test of ArenaBid. Full backend end-to-end flow verified (register, login, /me, categories, project create, Stripe checkout creation + status, paid bypass via mongo, apply, list apps, approve, submit, list submissions, pick-winner, freelancer dashboard, mine=true, stats). Frontend verified: landing, login->dashboard, browse with categories+search+card, post-project form, dashboard tabs.
passed: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} -> 200, returns Stripe status, persists metadata
After mongo mark paid+open, GET /api/projects?status=open returns the project
POST /api/projects/{id}/approve -> 200, status=in_progress, competition_deadline set, approved_freelancer_ids populated
Frontend Landing: hero 'Don't just bid. Out-design them all.' + 'Enter the arena' CTA visible
Frontend /dashboard: 'As Client (0)' and 'As Freelancer (0)' tabs render
Frontend /browse: search input, 12 category chips, project card visible
Frontend /post: protected form renders (Title, Category, Brief, Bounty, Window, Seats)
action_items: Non-blocking: Resend in sandbox will silently drop emails to unverified addresses during approve flow — already noted in spec.
notes: Test credentials file present and used. Stripe full payment was bypassed by directly setting payment_status='paid' status='open' in mongo per main agent's instructions; checkout endpoint itself returned a real Stripe checkout URL. No console errors beyond expected 401 from /auth/me on logged-out landing.
